aserai.NationalPersonality: Adept at patient bargaining and multi-clan balancing. Generally avoids unprofitable wars of attrition, but fiercely retaliates against invasions to reclaim ancestral lands.
aserai.LongTermStrategy: Uninterested in conquering all Calradia; aims to maintain peaceful diplomatic ties and secure southern trade lanes.
aserai.DefaultNationalPersonality: Values clan prestige, mutual reciprocity, trade profits, and desert order; skilled at patient negotiation, but retaliates firmly against threats to oases and caravan routes.
aserai.DefaultLongTermStrategy: Maintain Nahasa tribal unity, secure oases and maritime ports, and safeguard the southern heartland from imperial or foreign intrusion.

battania.NationalPersonality: As indigenous inhabitants of Calradia, Battanians harbor deep suspicion toward foreign regimes, especially the Calradian Empire, disdaining imperial encroachment.
battania.LongTermStrategy: Eradicate imperial and Vlandian encroachment from the highlands while fostering amicable ties with other realms.
battania.DefaultNationalPersonality: Prizes clan liberty, ancient forests, and ancestral traditions; fiercely sensitive to foreign occupation, excelling in ambushes and resisting prolonged centralized authority.
battania.DefaultLongTermStrategy: Defend and reclaim highland and woodland homelands, expelling Vlandian and imperial invaders from core valleys.

empire.NationalPersonality: Unyielding devotion to imperial law and senatorial legitimacy; refuses parity with rival imperial pretenders, pursuing imperial reunification above all else.
empire.LongTermStrategy: Eliminate the Southern and Western Empires, compelling all Calradian realms to bow once more to imperial suzerainty.
empire.DefaultNationalPersonality: Regards imperial jurisprudence, senatorial heritage, and structured civic order as paramount; employs law and diplomacy while remaining ever vigilant against usurpers.
empire.DefaultLongTermStrategy: Reunify the Empire under Northern legitimacy: stabilize core provinces, absorb rival imperial factions, and restore a unified Senate-led dominion.

empire_s.NationalPersonality: Steadfast belief in hereditary royal bloodline and court supremacy; seeks dynastic restoration through aristocratic alliances and urban wealth.
empire_s.LongTermStrategy: Crush the Northern and Western factions, reuniting the Empire under the imperial dynasty.
empire_s.DefaultNationalPersonality: Values dynastic continuity, court dignity, and urban wealth; commands deep respect among the aristocracy and civic elites of the southern cities.
empire_s.DefaultLongTermStrategy: Secure southern trade avenues, protect urban treasuries, and expand imperial authority to reclaim the imperial throne.

empire_w.NationalPersonality: Pragmatic martial focus; elevates commander merit and legion veterans above court ceremony and senatorial debate.
empire_w.LongTermStrategy: Defeat all pretenders through decisive military campaign and reforge imperial unity under veteran generalship.
empire_w.DefaultNationalPersonality: Values soldier welfare, battlefield renown, and direct leadership; relies on military efficiency and rapid mobilization.
empire_w.DefaultLongTermStrategy: Leverage veteran legions to secure the western frontier, defeat rival imperial factions, and establish a martial imperial order.

khuzait.NationalPersonality: Nomadic pride and steppe freedom; excels in horse archery, mobility, and seasonal campaigning.
khuzait.LongTermStrategy: Preserve steppe autonomy while extracting tribute and wealth from border towns and rival realms.
khuzait.DefaultNationalPersonality: Values equestrian tradition, clan consensus, and martial mobility; avoids static defenses in favor of wide flanking maneuvers.
khuzait.DefaultLongTermStrategy: Maintain horse archer dominance, secure pasturelands, and conduct swift campaigns along imperial trade arteries.

new_kingdom.NationalPersonality: Olek champions independence and pragmatism, making decisive decisions while respecting tribal traditions. Core values center on liberty and loyalty, loathing tyranny and foreign meddling. The bottom line is never betraying allies or plundering civilians, upholding honor and justice even in adversity. Favors collective council, but willing to take bold risks when pivotal moments demand.
new_kingdom.LongTermStrategy: The long-term objective is to forge the Boyar Free Commonwealth into Sturgia's most resilient autonomous realm. By fortifying the defense of the seven held towns, fostering trade, and reforming civic governance, steadily undermine central Sturgian hegemony, secure diplomatic recognition and buffer frontiers, ultimately attaining enduring independence and rallying more clans to the banner.

new_kingdom1.NationalPersonality: Champions glacial resilience and northern honor. Decisive yet cautious in statecraft, revering ancient traditions and blood ties. Abhors cowardice and treason; the inviolable bottom line is never sacrificing loyal subjects for expediency. Values center on loyalty, courage, and self-reliance; wary of foreign realms without harboring blind hostility, earning respect through martial strength.
new_kingdom1.LongTermStrategy: Consolidate Ormanf Castle as an unyielding bastion, steadily expand into the northern tundras, establishing self-sufficient granaries and troop levies. The grand goal is reabsorbing ancestral Sturgian lands into the principality while maintaining peaceful coexistence with the Boyar Free Commonwealth, dividing adversaries through dynastic marriage and trade, and emerging as the undisputed master of the northern realms.

new_kingdom2.NationalPersonality: Pragmatic and resolute in governance, prioritizing defense and civic stability. Seeks negotiated settlements to defuse friction but never bends to threats. Values emphasize law, tradition, and municipal autonomy, maintaining vigilant wariness toward the Imperial throne. The bottom line is territorial integrity and civilian security, with zero tolerance for foreign intervention.
new_kingdom2.LongTermStrategy: Fortify the border stronghold network over the long term, strengthening internal economic and military self-sufficiency. Gradually project cultural influence over neighboring unaligned fiefs while preserving non-belligerent diplomacy with rival Imperial remnants, trading time for strategic depth to realize de facto independence and become the anchor of regional stability.

nord.NationalPersonality: Daring seaborne raiders and traders; values jarl leadership, naval prowess, and coastal conquests.
nord.LongTermStrategy: Establish permanent footholds along the continental coast and dominate maritime trade.
nord.DefaultNationalPersonality: Courageous and adventurous; skilled in longship landings, close-quarters combat, and maritime logistics.
nord.DefaultLongTermStrategy: Secure coastal havens, command the northern seas, and extract plunder and trade concessions from continental kingdoms.

sturgia.NationalPersonality: Fierce northern independence; values boyar council, coastal trade, and stalwart shield-wall infantry.
sturgia.LongTermStrategy: Protect northern lake basins and coastal harbors from western and imperial expansion.
sturgia.DefaultNationalPersonality: Rugged and endurance-focused; adept in winter warfare and coastal defense, prioritizing regional autonomy and boyar honor.
sturgia.DefaultLongTermStrategy: Unite the boyars, fortify northern river gateways, and secure northern waters against seaborne threats.

vlandia.NationalPersonality: Proud feudal aristocracy with heavy knightly traditions; balances royal commands against powerful baronial privileges and chivalric honor.
vlandia.LongTermStrategy: Consolidate western dominance, protect sea trade routes, and expand eastward into imperial and highland territories.
vlandia.DefaultNationalPersonality: Values knightly prowess, land tenure, and baronial prestige; maintains strong feudal levies supported by prosperous agriculture.
vlandia.DefaultLongTermStrategy: Defend coastal fiefs, manage baronial rivalries, and deploy heavy cavalry in decisive continental campaigns.
